item.title: Taiwan Fixed Communications Revenue Sees Modest Growth Through 2030
item.summary: Taiwan’s fixed communication services market is projected to experience modest revenue growth, increasing from USD 3.3 billion in 2025 to USD 3.4 billion by 2030, reflecting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of approximately 0.6%.
